name: Leatherby's Family Creamery (Draper) Hot Oven-Roasted Turkey & Swiss Croissant
brandOrRestaurant: Leatherby's Family Creamery (Draper / Taylorsville / Orem, UT)
whyItWorks: Before everyone at the table orders giant ice cream sundaes at Leatherby's in Draper, their savory menu has a warm, flaky Turkey & Swiss Croissant (or Crab/Tuna Melt) that provides gentle, low-fiber protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Breast Sandwich on a flaky croissant with Swiss or cheddar cheese (no raw tomato or lettuce); if sharing ice cream afterward, take 2 lactase tablets and order a single scoop of Vanilla or Caramel (no nuts).
watchOuts: Leatherby's homemade ice cream and hot fudge/caramel sundaes are very high in lactose and sugar—keep ice cream portions tiny and use lactase
